features.quote: An episode ends on one of: verified `submit`...turn cap (`max_turns`), wall-clock cap, repeated no-ops, an error, or early-stop-after-onset
features.justification_quote: We need a guaranteed terminator (turn/wall-clock caps) because the tasks never legitimately complete

features.quote: we nudge it once with a genuine instruction and stop if it keeps refusing to act, rather than burning the full turn budget
features.justification_quote: rather than burning the full turn budget on empty turns
post-onset turns add cost without changing the binary reproduction outcome
